opening.headline: Positive start likely: Wall Street weak, Asia negative, crude easing
drivers: GIFT Nifty 25,922.0 (+103 pts, +0.40% vs Nifty's last close).
Asia this morning: Nikkei -2.78%, Hang Seng -1.14%, Kospi -6.16%.
Currency, crude and volatility: Brent 88.21 (-3.49%); USD/INR 92.220 (-0.75%); India VIX 17.70 (-0.01%).

story: Nifty 50 opened at 25,658, a gap-up of 1.22% from the previous close of 25,350.
The index dipped to a low of 25,620 (+1.07%) around 9:15 AM and touched a high of 25,952 (+2.37%) around 11:45 AM.
It settled at 25,819 (+1.85%), in the middle of the day's range, a session of two-way trade.
42 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 7 declined; Bank Nifty moved in line (+1.79%).
Latest institutional data (23 Nov): FII/FPI net +5673 Cr, DII net -2760 Cr.
risks: Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,201.09 (-0.50%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$88.21 (-3.49%); a sharp fall would help oil marketers and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 92.220 (-0.75%), US 10-year yield 4.90% (-0.28%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 25,922.0 (+0.40% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
